text.zh-CN: 原报告先于入院后 8 小时切开减压，48 小时后行升主动脉、弓部置换及象鼻术；切开 1 周后二期缝合，术后 35 天出院。此顺序为历史记录，不是等待策略。
text.en: The source reports decompression eight hours after admission, aortic/arch repair with elephant-trunk procedure at 48 hours, delayed wound closure after a week and discharge 35 days after surgery. These are historical intervals, not a waiting strategy.

text.zh-CN: 单纯肌肉拉伤

text.zh-CN: 只存在静脉血栓
text.en: Venous thrombosis alone

feedback.zh-CN: 动脉流失和 CTA 指向不同机制。
feedback.en: Absent arterial flow and CTA indicate another mechanism.

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。

text.zh-CN: 立即启动主动脉及肢体救治团队，协调紧急修复与减压
text.en: Activate aortic and limb-salvage teams immediately to coordinate urgent repair and decompression

feedback.zh-CN: A 型夹层合并灌注不良是紧急外科情境。
feedback.en: Type A dissection with malperfusion requires emergency surgical assessment.

text.zh-CN: 按原报告固定等 48 小时再修复

feedback.zh-CN: 历史时间线不是当前等待指令。

feedback.en: Clinical limb ischaemia is already present.

knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: A 型主动脉夹层以急性肢体缺血和筋膜室问题就诊，需要同时关注主动脉与肢体。
conclusion.en: Type A dissection presented through acute limb ischaemia and compartment pathology, requiring attention to both aorta and limb.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 孤立肢体症状可来自近端主动脉。
keyReasoning.en: Apparently isolated limb symptoms may originate in the proximal aorta.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: ACC/AHA 2022 支持 A 型夹层合并肢体灌注不良的紧急修复评估。
keyReasoning.en: ACC/AHA 2022 supports emergency repair assessment in type A dissection with limb malperfusion.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 原报告时序不能转写成当前允许延误。
